title: Blank pattern template
description: Copy this structure when you create a pattern. Delete what does not apply.
root_cause: Fields: title (searchable), category, error_signature (exact text of the symptom), description (what happens, when), root_cause (why), diagnosis_steps (how to confirm), quick_fix (fast way out), root_fix (lasting fix), severity, tags.
diagnosis_steps:
Worked example (create with POST /api/v1/memory):
{
  "title": "Certificate renewal fails: port 80 closed",
  "category": "incident",
  "error_signature": "Timeout during connect (likely firewall problem)",
  "description": "certbot renew fails on a server where port 80 was closed by the firewall.",
  "root_cause": "The HTTP challenge needs port 80 open.",
  "diagnosis_steps": "1. sudo certbot renew --dry-run  2. check the firewall rules for port 80",
  "quick_fix": "Open port 80, renew, close it again if needed.",
  "root_fix": "Keep port 80 open and redirect it to HTTPS in nginx.",
  "severity": "medium",
  "tags": "certbot,https,firewall"
}
Only title is required. error_signature should hold the exact text of the symptom, it is what the next search will match.
root_fix: root_fix: what removes the cause for good.
